record.title: Evaluate the startup dependency against the hardware stop condition
record.intent: Stop at a useful UI or hardware modeling boundary, otherwise select one bounded environment reconstruction.
requirements: Do not replace real program behavior merely to make the UI appear functional.
Treat unexpected material architecture evidence as a decision requiring reconciliation.
Keep work local and preserve all negative evidence.
acceptance: State the observed dependency, supporting evidence and unresolved uncertainty.
Record a terminal operator report or draft one small successor batch under standing authorization.
